title: V11.20 Unattributed Finding Line
description: Schema for ONE line of ~/.agent-metrics/unattributed-findings.jsonl. Written by wave-review-attribute and swarm-review-attribute when a finding cannot be mapped to a task via v11_resolve_file_to_task. Findings are NEVER dropped silently — they land here with a reason for investigation. Periodically reviewed; entries can be re-resolved retroactively if task-state catches up.

file.description: The finding's file path that failed resolution.

line.description: Line number from the finding, if present.

error_id.description: Error ID from the finding (e.g. 'E1', 'E2'), if present.

attribution_key.description: OPTIONAL: a deterministic key is only computable when project+task_id+file+line+error_id are all present. Findings with reason in (parse_ambiguity, file_missing_in_artifacts) typically lack a computable key and omit this field. Findings with reason in (file_outside_task_scope, task_found_no_owner) have a file and therefore a key, used for retroactive re-resolution if task-state catches up.

reason.description: Why resolution failed. file_outside_task_scope=no task's files_changed includes the file. no_completed_tasks_in_project=project has no tasks with artifacts. parse_ambiguity=swarm markdown parser could not extract a file. file_missing_in_artifacts=finding has no file field. task_state_unreadable=I/O failure. task_found_no_owner=a task DID touch the file (files_changed match) but active_agent_id was null/empty at attribution time — distinct from file_outside_task_scope; triage path is different (chase down the owner, not the file).

source_report.description: Absolute path to the source wave-reports/*.json or audit-report.md file that originated this finding. Useful for re-resolution after task-state updates.
